stanzas: There is but one God whose name is true, the Creator, devoid of fear and enmity, immortal, unborn, self-existent; by the favour of the Guru.
The True One was in the beginning; the True One was in the primal age.
The True One is now also, O Nanak; the True One also shall be.
en.credit: The opening lines, translated by Max Arthur Macauliffe, The Sikh Religion, volume 1 (1909)
